sistema-orientacion-ureal.title: Vocational Guidance System (UREAL)
sistema-orientacion-ureal.problem: Universidad Real processed vocational guidance and aptitude tests entirely on paper — losing data, moving slowly, looking unprofessional to prospective students.
sistema-orientacion-ureal.solution: Full-stack PHP/MySQL web platform: expert guidance system, automated evaluation module, admin panel, and full UML documentation under XP methodology.
sistema-orientacion-ureal.result: 100% automated process deployed to production. The institution replaced the manual workflow entirely; the system remains live and manageable without technical intervention.
sistema-orientacion-ureal.shortDesc: Web platform that replaced the manual student recruitment process at Universidad Real, putting vocational guidance into real production.

instrum-la-paz.title: Instrum — La Paz
instrum-la-paz.problem: A musical instrument shop in La Paz needed a premium digital presence with autonomous catalog management — no developer dependency for every update.
instrum-la-paz.solution: Jamstack platform with React + Framer Motion + Decap CMS. The owner updates the catalog via a visual panel, no code required. Aggressive SEO optimized for local searches in La Paz.
instrum-la-paz.result: Live production site, self-managed. Positioned for key musical instrument searches in La Paz.
instrum-la-paz.shortDesc: Premium instrument store with built-in CMS. The owner updates the catalog without depending on the developer.

portfolio-anterior.title: Previous Portfolio — Before / After
portfolio-anterior.problem: The existing portfolio (vanilla HTML/CSS/JS/PHP) accumulated technical debt, lacked real internationalization, and didn't clearly communicate the developer's value or make contact easy.
portfolio-anterior.solution: Complete rebuild in Next.js App Router + TypeScript + Tailwind + next-intl. New visual identity, conversion-focused copy, technical SEO and modern architecture — what you're looking at now.
portfolio-anterior.result: Portfolio with new identity, two indexable languages and load time < 1s. Experience that used to take 4 seconds is now instant.
portfolio-anterior.shortDesc: Own redesign: from HTML/CSS/PHP portfolio to the modern stack you're looking at now. The best proof of technical judgment.

valdivia-asociados.title: Valdivia & Asociados
valdivia-asociados.problem: Boutique law firm in La Paz with no digital presence, losing potential business clients by not appearing in relevant searches.
valdivia-asociados.solution: Multi-page corporate site with React + Vite, aggressive technical SEO (meta tags, Open Graph, JSON-LD, sitemap, robots), Decap CMS for content management, and a design that conveys seriousness and trust.
valdivia-asociados.result: Firm indexed in Google with complete metadata. Live site with fully operational contact form and autonomous content management.
valdivia-asociados.shortDesc: Corporate site for La Paz boutique firm with complete technical SEO — OG tags, JSON-LD, sitemap — and built-in CMS.

sistema-panaderia.title: Cash Flow & Inventory System — Bakery
sistema-panaderia.problem: A bakery managed cash flow and inventory with notebooks, causing frequent errors, no records, and no visibility of what entered and exited each shift.
sistema-panaderia.solution: Cash flow and inventory management system, small-scale, designed for 1 bakery employee. React + Supabase + PostgreSQL. Minimal interface, no learning curve.
sistema-panaderia.result: Employee registers sales, expenses and inventory from any device. Zero cash closing errors since implementation.
sistema-panaderia.shortDesc: Cash flow and inventory management system, small-scale, designed for 1 bakery employee.

crm-freelance.title: Freelance CRM — Own System
crm-freelance.problem: Tracking clients, projects and payments in spreadsheets is inefficient and doesn't scale. A freelancer needed full visibility over their pipeline.
crm-freelance.solution: Custom CRM built with React + Supabase + TypeScript. Client management, projects, payment status and notes. Private access, secure authentication. Directly demonstrates the ability to build this type of system for your business.
crm-freelance.result: Operational tool used daily. Administrative time reduced. Direct proof that a similar CRM can be built for your company.
crm-freelance.metric: System built and actively in use
crm-freelance.shortDesc: Custom freelance CRM with React + Supabase. Demonstrates the ability to build this type of system for any business.
